short_description: Forecast near-term cash and liquidity risks.
description: Build a 30/60/90-day cash-flow forecast from AR, AP, opening cash, timing assumptions, and fixed costs.

requires: Authorized SandBase connection for capability calls

install.prompt: Use $cash-flow-snapshot to forecast our next 90 days of cash.
install.cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill cash-flow-snapshot --agent codex
install.global_cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill cash-flow-snapshot --agent codex --global

examples: Will opening cash cover payroll next month?
Extract these authorized AR and AP reports and flag liquidity risks.
notes: Call sandbase_inspect before each capability and pass only current schema-defined arguments.
Do not mutate external systems without explicit user authorization.

schema_resolution.dynamic_lookup: Use tool_name as a discovery hint with sandbase_discover; pass the matching returned name to sandbase_inspect and follow execute_as with the current inputSchema.

endpoints.summary: Extract requested structured fields from a selected page.
Read a selected page as clean Markdown.
